data.one_liner: Customizable interactive command-line components for Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of command-line components like text and password inputs, radio or select lists, checkboxes, spinners, and progress bars. Supports customizable themes and exception handling to restore terminal defaults.
use_when: Building command-line applications in Dart that require user interaction
Displaying spinners and progress bars in terminal scripts
avoid_when: Developing graphical user interfaces for Flutter apps
Writing code for platforms other than desktop/CLI environments
strengths: Easy to use and customizable CLI components
weaknesses: Limited to command-line and terminal use cases
Using multiple spinners concurrently requires special care via MultiSpinner to avoid breaking rendering
